1469 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Subtract 84 days from 1469-01-19:  
First, subtract 19 days → 1469-01-00 is 1468-12-31.  
Remaining 65 days to subtract: go back into December 1468.  
December has 31 days, so 1468-12-31 minus 31 days = 1468-11-30.  
Remaining 34 days: November has 30 days, so 1468-11-30 minus 30 days = 1468-10-31.  
Remaining 4 days: 1468-10-31 minus 4 days = 1468-10-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1468-10-27
